overview_description.description: Alba Orbital build and design small commercial satellite platforms. Traditionally satellites have been very expensive, even the smallest commercial satellites like CubeSats cost six-figure amounts to build and launch. Alba Orbital develops pico-Satellites which weigh <1kg and cost significantly less. While offering almost all of the advantages of a CubeSat. Being leaders in this niche, they are closely partnered with ESA and provide research in this area to them.

about_short_description.short_description: Alba Orbital is a pico-satellite company that builds and designs small commercial satellite platforms.

product.name: Unicorn-2 PocketQube Satellite Platform
product.description: A 3-unit PocketQube satellite platform designed for small satellite missions with integrated payload and power systems.

product.name: AlbaPod PocketQube Deployer
product.description: A deployer system for launching multiple PocketQube satellites, compatible with various PocketQube sizes and launch vehicles.

product.name: Alba Launch Cluster Service
product.description: A launch service offering regular rideshare opportunities for PocketQube satellites to low Earth orbit.

product.name: Alba Connect Ground Station Network
product.description: A ground station service supporting communication and data downlink for PocketQube satellite missions.

product.name: NightLights Satellite Imagery Service
product.description: A satellite imagery service providing high-resolution night-time Earth images using Unicorn-2 satellites.
